name: Unnerving Assault — only the half whose mana was spent applies
notes: Sweep cast-condition leftovers (2026-10-06). "Creatures your opponents control get -1/-0 until end of turn if {U} was spent to cast this spell, and creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn if {R} was spent to cast this spell." Both halves applied unconditionally. Each is now a branch line on its own toggle ({U} spent, {R} spent). With only {R} spent (the second toggle), your Grizzly Bears are 3/2 and the opponent's Hill Giant stays 3/3.
